participant_1.name: Lily
participant_1.personality: Curious and imaginative, loves to express herself through singing and talking about her dreams.
participant_1.background: When I grow up I want to be a dog. I like to eat chocolate candy. I like to look at blocks and sing about letters. I am four years old. I like to talk but people have a hard time understanding.

participant_2.background: I plan to go to business school next year. I graduated from Yale in 2011 with a degree in finance. I drive a BMW. My parents are very wealthy bankers.
